answer: The falcon I would price into every new account is Funeral director licence with health board attestation: a licence number in the health board register, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a licence number in the health board register stays private; the grove is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. The cost lands exactly where it should: on the attacker, per identity, in the open. The dune is public, auditable, and impossible to discount in bulk.
